name: usage-band
description: Claude Code mod: a one-line band above the prompt showing context, 5-hour and 7-day usage, and session cost, with a small dancer that dances while Claude works, then dozes off. Runs code inside Claude Code; Claude Code only; needs 2.1.287 or later.

dancer.title: Dancer (default always)
dancer.description: A small figure at the end of the band. always: dances while Claude works, hums for a minute after, dozes for four more, then sleeps and stops redrawing. working: only while Claude works. off: none. Default: always.

ascii.title: ASCII dancer (default off)
ascii.description: Draw the dancer with ~ * o > < instead of the symbols ♪ ♫ • °. Turn on if the band looks misaligned (some East Asian terminals draw those symbols double width). Default: off.
